SELECT r.REP_ID, r.REP_NM, r.TERR_ID, r.DISTRICT_ID, r.TEAM, g.BRAND_NM, g.FQTR, g.TRX_GOAL
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r LEFT JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.IC_GOAL g ON g.REP_ID=r.REP_ID
WHERE r.DISTRICT_ID='D-03' ORDER BY r.REP_ID, g.FQTR, g.BRAND_NM
SELECT DISTINCT WK_END_DT FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY WHERE WK_END_DT >= '2026-06-01' ORDER BY 1

WITH wk AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT WK_END_DT) AS elapsed_wks, MIN(WK_END_DT) AS first_wk, MAX(WK_END_DT) AS last_wk
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY WHERE WK_END_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
), trx AS (
  SELECT p.TERR_ID, SUM(x.TRX_QTY) AS qtd_trx, COUNT(DISTINCT x.WK_END_DT) AS terr_wks
  FROM PHARMA_DEMO.RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY x
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRODUCT pr ON pr.PROD_NDC11 = x.PROD_NDC11 AND pr.BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA'
  JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.PRESCRIBER p ON p.PRSCRBR_ME = x.PRSCRBR_ME
  WHERE x.WK_END_DT BETWEEN '2026-07-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  GROUP BY p.TERR_ID
)
SELECT r.REP_ID, r.REP_NM, r.TEAM, r.TERR_ID, g.TRX_GOAL, t.qtd_trx, t.terr_wks, w.elapsed_wks, w.first_wk, w.last_wk,
  ROUND(g.TRX_GOAL * w.elapsed_wks / 13, 1) AS paced_goal,
  ROUND(t.qtd_trx / (g.TRX_GOAL * w.elapsed_wks / 13) * 100, 1) AS attain_pct
FROM PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.REP_ROSTER r
JOIN PHARMA_DEMO.CORE.IC_GOAL g ON g.REP_ID = r.REP_ID AND g.BRAND_NM = 'LACRIVIA' AND g.FQTR = '2026Q3'
LEFT JOIN trx t ON t.TERR_ID = r.TERR_ID
CROSS JOIN wk w
WHERE r.DISTRICT_ID = 'D-03'
ORDER BY r.REP_ID
